title: By far the best habit tracking app!
body:
Guys this is the best habit/goal tracking app on the market. Believe me I tried every single one.

For each habit you can create cards like milestones, charts, counters and notes. You can add the milestone card many times and change the header to rewards, to buy or anything else. Note taking or journaling is also very good for diet/fitness tracking or expense tracking habits.

Why do you stop improving this app? It was over one year since the last update. I will be very happy to see web/iPad version and printing functions for notes or the whole dashboard.

This app is worth every penny you pay.
Please keep up good work!

Cheers

author: steffen.m

title: Horrible last Update
body:
The last update has significantly worsen all workflows for me. 
Now I can’t see in the today habit tablewview overview which habits I have already accomplished today. Instead of a  check mark there is only a number. There is no way to check ‘which habits have I not fulfilled today yet’. In fact it seem like the Today tab and the All tab carry the exact same information (???)
In the calendar view it’s not possible to check a day with force touch anymore. That was such an important feature. This feature was replaced by the far less more important ‚skip feature‘ which is totally non sense for me. You could have placed the skip feature more locally. For example in the habit main Screen it self. 
I don’t like the new pop up for adding check in’s either. It takes now 3 clicks instead of one to check in for an old day... you could have let force touch for one day and normal tap for the multiple check in pop up. 
It happens often that I forget to check in for one day and have to check in for the day before. So the whole process takes up significantly more time. I’m pretty sure that’s the case for most people too. 

Please come back to the old quality UX workflows or something that is just as easy and I will update to 5 stars. Guys I have been a big fan but this update is a huge step back for me

UPDATE:
Dev Team reacted quite quick - the last update has significantly improved the check in experience once again. Happy to have single tap check in back. I like the solution with the small +\- pop up. Much better than the big screen solution. 

Thank you for the last update. 
Changed my rating to 5 stars ;-)

PS: one last issue remaining:
In the Habit tableView (burger Menu)
When you swipe a cell from right to left (check in) you can only see a number in the circle becoming +1. I believe earlier it changed in a way to mark that you have checked in that habit today. I understand this has been changed to make room for multiple check in per days, but still some kind of marker would be nice. This way you just don’t know which habits you have checked in at least once today. ( with the Green checkmark you were able to quickly check what habits you still have left todo)
